# rsync exclude patterns for skill backups.
# Patterns are relative to ~/.agents/skills/. One per line.
# These are volatile runtime/state files that churn every session and
# only add noise to the backup history.

semantic-patterns.json

# self-improving-agent episodic memory (auto-generated session entries)
episodic/

# Nested repositories must be backed up as ordinary directories.
.git/
